summary: Weekly or monthly CSV of newly registered LLCs and corporations from state Secretary of State public filings. With 5.5M new US businesses formed in 2025 (+6.5% YoY), the first-30-days window is the highest-value prospecting window for insurance agents, accountants, CPAs, web designers, registered agent services, and payroll companies. State SOS bulk data is public in most states; the gap is a cleaned, filterable, cheap one-time file targeting a specific state or niche.

audience.who: B2B service providers who sell to brand-new small businesses: commercial insurance agents, bookkeepers, CPAs, website designers, registered agent firms, payroll processors, and business banking reps. All want to reach owners in the first 30-60 days before competitors do.

data_wanted: Entity name, entity type (LLC/Corp/etc.), state of registration, registered agent name and address, filing date, principal address (where available), officer/organizer names — all pulled from public SOS bulk data files.

evidence.source: Registered Agents Inc New Business Formations Report — tracks all 50 states monthly, free to economists; proves public data availability and consistent audience interest
evidence.quote: The New Business Formations Report data is made free to economists, journalists, policymakers, and entrepreneurs every month.

evidence.source: Wolters Kluwer analysis — 5.5M new businesses in 2025, up 6.5% YoY, signals large addressable market of newly incorporated businesses
evidence.quote: Nearly 5.5 million new businesses formed in 2025, signaling durable entrepreneurial momentum.

evidence.source: Kyckr — commercial California business registry data product, pricing proof that formatted SOS data is sold
LLC University — all 50 state SOS business entity search portals are public and accessible
evidence.quote: Secretary of State Business Entity Search (all 50 states)

willingness_to_pay.signal: Commercial lead vendors charge $0.25-$1.00 per new business record. Insurance agencies pay $50-200/month for new-business lead subscriptions. A one-time state-specific file (e.g., "Texas LLCs filed April 2026, 4,200 records") priced at $39-79 undercuts all subscription services and the per-record pricing on Fiverr gigs for the same data.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + targeted post in r/Insurance, r/Accounting, r/smallbusiness, r/Entrepreneur
first_sale_path.angle: "[State] New LLCs & Corps — [Month] 2026 — [N] records, CSV" — cleaned, ready-to-import list of every business formed in the last 30 days in a high-formation state (Texas, Florida, California). Angle: 'Reach them before everyone else. No subscription needed.'
